purpose: Single authority for an agent session: bounded states, bound worktree and claim, and five measured counters. A session that is not in this machine is prose, not a session.
principles: Machine-readable first: session states and transitions are strictly typed data, never prose.
One session binds one worktree and one claim identity; sharing either across sessions is a fork, not reuse.
No mutation without read-back proof: open, claim, proof, release, and close are all observed facts.
Unknown is data: a missing observation is recorded as unknown, never filled with a plausible value.

session_state_machine.rule: No state is skipped. A session that proves without a claim proves nothing; its proof is unattributed.

bindings.worktree: Allocated from verified origin/main via the isolated-worktree surface. One session, one worktree.
bindings.claim: Claim identity is per session (agent_id carries the session). The claim records base_sha at grant time.
bindings.staleness: Status surfaces base_sha drift: behind_count of base_sha behind origin/main at read time.

green_main_gate.rule: No session opens on a red main. Allocation refuses while a mandatory gate is red on origin/main.
green_main_gate.toll: A branch that pays main debt records one toll_paid counter per debt family, not per commit.

gc_rule.rule: A worktree is collectable only on two independent facts: claim released AND head reachable from a durable ref.

counters.counts: main-debt families paid by a branch that is not their owner
retain vs collect verdicts with their two-fact evidence
stale-base observations before they become mystery failures
shared-checkout HEAD moves under a live session
expired vs forked vs renewed leases; outcome is one of expired, forked, renewed

close_receipt.rule: Close appends one receipt to the coordination log. No receipt means the session is still open.
